editorial:
Imagine trying to start over after the whole world saw you acting crazy on camera. That is exactly where you find Nell Sweetzer. She is just trying to live a normal life, but the demon from the first movie is not done with her yet. You get a feeling of dread right away because you know she is being hunted. The vibe is much darker than the first one, moving away from the fake documentary style and becoming more of a scary movie that keeps you on edge. It feels like a nightmare that you cannot wake up from, and you will find yourself rooting for Nell to escape her fate.

What really works here is how the movie handles the scares. The acting is solid, and the twists will keep you guessing until the end. While some parts move a bit slow, the big payoffs are worth it. If you love supernatural thrillers, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the demon was using Nell to build a portal for more evil spirits to enter our world. Nell fights back with the help of a few allies, but it takes a huge toll. She eventually manages to stop the demon from fully taking over, but the movie leaves you wondering if the evil is truly gone or just waiting for another chance to strike again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves possession movies and dark twists.
